original_test_intent: Validate the hot-swap-controller board's management path, channel status and telemetry while leaving gates, current limits, latches and power delivery unchanged.
original_method: The referenced HSC procedure and criteria are absent. No discovery or register access is permitted until board/channel identity, BMC mux route, read allowlist, expected state and independent power recovery are approved and reviewed again.
manual_activity: Power/platform owners must define the exact HSC board and channel/gate mapping, non-mutating status registers, normal/fault expectations and out-of-band recovery.
required_inputs: Hot-swap channel, load and gate topology
Reserved control, latch-clear and fault-injection exclusions
safety_requirements: Do not scan unknown HSC buses or addresses
Do not touch gate-enable, current-limit, reset or latch-clear registers
Do not use force, quick-write or write-capable transactions
Verify stable load and redundancy before approved reads
Preserve power-good, telemetry and BMC events
Stop on any gate, output, current, fault, management or bus change
agent_execution_scope: Perform no I2C enumeration or register access
Keep PDB and HSC acceptance separate
engineer_actions: Define BMC route and read-only register matrix
Provide isolation, abort and independent recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: An all-adapter i2cdetect loop cannot choose the HSC mux branch or distinguish harmless status registers from gate/current-limit control. It neither maps responders to hot-swap channels nor records power-good and load state, and its output is incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: BLOCKED: supply the channel-aware HSC register and recovery contract before choosing any bus operation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HSC_BD and the two-minute time estimates are retained; no controller, channel, address or register is fabricated.

modernized_recommendation.status: PENDING HSC BOARD AND POWER-GATE CONTRACT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After approval, read only allowlisted identity, status and telemetry registers on named HSC channels over the documented BMC/OOB route; correlate them with power-good, load, PSU/PDB telemetry and BMC events while proving gate state is unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines channel- and register-specific observation instead of generic address probing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: I2C presence cannot prove correct hot-swap channel mapping, current-limit configuration, power-good state or fault-latch behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: HSC devices combine measurement, fault latches and gate control; the wrong transaction can remove or sequence power, so recovery must remain independent from the active controller path.

expected_evidence: Approved HSC specification and fresh review
Exact allowlisted status/telemetry reads and raw responses
Synchronized PSU/PDB/BMC SEL/SDR and system-state evidence
Proof of unchanged gates/output plus abort/recovery audit and owner verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row is not contradictory, but both operative fields depend on an unavailable HSC specification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The missing HSC register semantics determine whether access reads status or manipulates power gates and faults. That core safety boundary cannot be guessed or reduced to package/approval readiness.

engineering_decision_request.question: Define Functionality row 1805 Wistron-HW-00007-V003 I2C HSC_BD: HSC board/revision and channel/gate/load mapping, BMC/OOB controller and mux route, address and safe identity/status/telemetry register allowlist, reserved control/latch exclusions, expected current/voltage/power-good/fault states, aborts and independent power recovery; preserve Master placeholders and require fresh review.

review_improvement: Separates passive HSC status evidence from power-gate, current-limit and fault-latch control, establishing why an undefined scan is a hard blocker.
independent_technical_reasoning: A hot-swap controller's bus interface governs a live power boundary. Identity, telemetry, fault clearing and gate control can coexist at one address, so bus discovery alone says nothing about safe semantics. Without channel mapping and a register allowlist, even a short probe can threaten SUT power and cannot produce an acceptance result.
